Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning veterinarian immunity from liability when reporting suspected animal cruelty.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to veterinarian immunity from liability whenreporting suspected animal cruelty; and adding a new section to chapter16.52 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A veterinarian lawfully licensed in this state to practiceveterinary medicine, surgery, and dentistry who reports, in good faithand in the normal course of business, a suspected incident of animalcruelty that is punishable under this chapter to the proper authoritiesis immune from liability in any civil or criminal action broughtagainst such veterinarian for reporting the suspected incident.
